note: 50 tasks. ENG-008 §1 targets 100 and permits 50 as an under-powered first pass; this is the permitted first pass and must be reported as under-powered, not as conclusive. Requests are written as a user would actually write them and are NOT copied from data/*.jsonl — copying would test memorization rather than task performance. Language mix is roughly half German, half English, matching the operator's real usage. The evaluation layer for these tasks lives in evaluation.json and must never appear in this file.
